title: Oven Smoked German Sausage Bowl
description: A kid-friendly German dish featuring smoked sausage, dried chillies, and a blend of spices, served in a dolsot stone bowl. This recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced onion and cubed potato with smoked paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the onion and potato mixture in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the onion and potato are roasting, slice the German sausage links and place them on a separate baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
After the onion and potato have roasted for 20 minutes, add the sliced sausage to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 15 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix the crushed dried chillies and chicken broth.
After the sausage has roasted for 15 minutes, brush the chilli and chicken broth mixture evenly over the sausage links.
Continue to roast the sausage, onion, and potato for an additional 5 minutes, or until the sausage is browned and the onion and potato are tender.
To serve, place a portion of the roasted sausage, onion, and potato into a dolsot stone bowl, then top with sauerkraut.
